replacements.Pascal y Leibniz construyeron máquinas q: Pascal and Leibniz built machines that could add and multiply. They calculated, but they could not decide. That leap took another two centuries.
replacements.Ruedas dentadas de 10 posiciones. Cuando: Ten-position toothed wheels. When one moves from 9 to 0, it advances the next wheel (mechanical carry). Brilliant, but it only knows one operation.
replacements.La rueda escalonada permite multiplicar: The stepped wheel enables multiplication by repeating mechanical additions. The operator turned the crank the required number of times. More versatile, but still unable to decide.
replacements.Ambas máquinas podían calcular <em>si se: Both machines could calculate if they were told exactly what to calculate. What they could not do was make decisions:
replacements.SI resultado &gt; 100 ENTONCES hacer A,: IF result > 100 THEN do A, ELSE do B
replacements.Requiere leer el resultado, compararlo y: This requires reading the result, comparing it and choosing a path. Neither mechanical machine could alter its own execution process.
